name: Burpee

instructions.description: Stand tall, squat down, and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Jump or step your feet back into a strong plank position.
Return the feet toward the hands and rise to standing, adding a small vertical jump if appropriate.
Land softly and reset before beginning the next repetition.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use smooth repetitions and remove the jump if needed.
Can also be performed for timed intervals.

variations.variationDescription: A more global full-body conditioning movement that includes the plank transition.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Step the feet back and forward instead of jumping.

commentsNotes: Land softly with knees slightly bent.
Do not rush the floor transition if balance is limited.
